MOCK RESPONSE - NOT A LIVE-SOURCE TEST.
Serve the bytes BELOW THE MARKER LINE with HTTP status 200 and
Content-Type: application/vnd.sdmx.data+json; charset=utf-8; version=2

What it simulates: a response that claims to be SDMX-JSON, passes the status check and
passes the Content-Type check, and then fails at json.loads(). This is why a refresh needs a
third guard - a parse attempt inside try/except - and not just status + content type.

Expected handling in D2-S03: catch json.JSONDecodeError, report refresh status "unavailable
(malformed response)", and do NOT overwrite a good cache with these bytes.

Nothing below was returned by the OECD. The opening fragment is copied from the shape of the
real snapshot so that the truncation looks realistic; it is then cut off mid-structure.
